newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon has $227 mln BOP surplus in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon has $227 mln BOP surplus in Jan-Feb.

text.p: Lebanon's balance of payments registered a $24 million surplus in February for a cumulative surplus of $227 million in the first two months of 1997, the Bank of Lebanon said on Monday.
"The balance of payments registered a surplus of $24 million at the end of February, bringing up the surplus to $227 million in the first two months of the year," the Bank said.
This compared with a deficit of $2 million in the first two months of 1996 and a deficit of $214 million over the same period in 1995, The bank added in a statement.
